math2-add-subtract-20.title: Snack Stand Facts
math2-add-subtract-20.tagline: Run a class snack stand and use fact strategies to count every snack.
math2-add-subtract-20.description: Students run a pretend snack stand. They add and subtract snack counts within 20 with make-a-ten and doubles, find missing numbers, and build a fact family menu board.

math2-odd-even-arrays.title: Classroom Seating Plan
math2-odd-even-arrays.tagline: Pair up partners and set the desks in neat arrays.
math2-odd-even-arrays.description: Students plan seats for a class event. They decide whether groups can be made into partners (odd or even), write even numbers as doubles, and arrange chairs in arrays with up to 5 rows and 5 columns.

math2-place-value-1000.title: Bead Shop Bundles
math2-place-value-1000.tagline: Pack beads in bags of ten and boxes of a hundred, then fill orders.
math2-place-value-1000.description: Students run a bead shop. Beads come in single beads, bags of 10 and boxes of 100. They pack orders, write order numbers with digits, words and expanded form, and explain place value.

math2-count-compare-1000.title: Library Shelf Hunt
math2-count-compare-1000.tagline: Find books by number, count along the shelves and compare book numbers.
math2-count-compare-1000.description: Students help a librarian. Books have numbers from 100 to 999. They count on and skip count to find books, compare book numbers with >, = and <, and use 10 more, 10 less, 100 more and 100 less to move along the shelves.

math2-add-subtract-100.title: Class Points Store
math2-add-subtract-100.tagline: Shop the class points store and explain your adding and subtracting strategies.
math2-add-subtract-100.description: Students spend class reward points (not real money) at a pretend store. They add and subtract within 100 with place value, add up to four prices, check with the related operation, and explain strategies.

math2-word-problems-100.title: Zoo Story Problems
math2-word-problems-100.tagline: Write and solve zoo story problems with bar models and equations.
math2-word-problems-100.description: Students visit a pretend zoo. They solve add-to, take-from, put-together, take-apart and compare stories with unknowns in every position, draw bar models, and write their own two-step story problem book.

math2-word-problems-100.title: School Carnival
math2-word-problems-100.tagline: Run carnival booths with tickets, prizes and team lines (Units 1–6).
math2-word-problems-100.description: A cumulative project for Units 1–6. Students plan a school carnival: ticket facts within 20, teams in pairs and arrays, prize counts in hundreds, tens and ones, comparing ticket totals, adding and subtracting within 100, and two-step booth stories.

math2-add-subtract-1000.title: Recycling Drive Report
math2-add-subtract-1000.tagline: Total the cans each class collects and report the results.
math2-add-subtract-1000.description: Students run a school recycling drive. They add and subtract three-digit numbers with base-ten models and written methods, compose and decompose tens and hundreds, and write a report of the results.

math2-measuring-length.title: Measure My Classroom
math2-measuring-length.tagline: Measure classroom objects with the right tools and show the data on a line plot.
math2-measuring-length.description: Students measure real classroom objects. They choose rulers, yardsticks, meter sticks or measuring tapes, measure in two units, estimate first, compare lengths, and make a line plot of pencil lengths.

math2-length-number-line.title: Paper Airplane Contest
math2-length-number-line.tagline: Fly paper airplanes, record distances on a number line and solve length problems.
math2-length-number-line.description: Students hold a paper airplane contest. They record flight lengths in feet, show them as lengths from 0 on a number line, add and subtract flights with jumps, and solve length word problems.

math2-time-money.title: Lemonade Stand
math2-time-money.tagline: Plan the stand's schedule with AM and PM and handle pretend coins and bills.
math2-time-money.description: Students plan a pretend lemonade stand. They write a schedule with times to five minutes and AM or PM, count coins and bills, use ¢ and $ correctly, and solve money problems with change.

math2-graphs-data.title: Class Survey Graphs
math2-graphs-data.tagline: Collect anonymous votes, make a picture graph and a bar graph, and answer questions.
math2-graphs-data.description: Students run an anonymous class survey (for example, a favorite fruit vote with tally marks). They make a picture graph and a single-unit bar graph with up to four categories and solve put-together, take-apart and compare problems.

math2-shapes-equal-shares.title: Paper Quilt Square
math2-shapes-equal-shares.tagline: Design a paper quilt square with shapes, rows of squares and equal shares.
math2-shapes-equal-shares.description: Students design a class paper quilt. They name and draw shapes by sides and angles, partition a rectangle into rows and columns of same-size squares, and color halves, thirds and fourths, explaining that equal shares can look different.

math2-shapes-equal-shares.title: Neighborhood Market Day
math2-shapes-equal-shares.tagline: Plan a pretend market with measuring, time, money, graphs and shapes (Units 7–12).
math2-shapes-equal-shares.description: A cumulative project for Units 7–12. Students plan a pretend neighborhood market: visitor totals within 1,000, measuring booth tables, a number-line map of the street, a schedule with AM and PM, play-money sales, a graph of favorite booths and booth signs cut into equal shares.
